definition: **化膿性肝膿瘍超音波：variable echogenicity、irregular border、thick wall with vascularity on color Doppler。Posterior acoustic shadow 非典型表現（那是 solid lesion/calcification 特徵）。**
keyPoints: **Thick wall with vascularity** on color Doppler。
**Posterior acoustic shadow → NOT typical**（為 solid lesion 特徵）。
name: Pyogenic Liver Abscess — Ultrasound
